newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine parliament awaits new privatisation head.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine parliament awaits new privatisation head.

text.p: Ukraine's privatisation plan for this year will have to wait until President Leonid Kuchma selects a new chief for the State Property Fund (FDM), the fund's deputy chief said on Wednesday.
"I believe parliamentary deputies are waiting to see who will be appointed chief, and then they will accept a plan," Alexander Bondar told reporters.
Kuchma's replacement for Yuri Yekhanurov, appointed minister of the economy last month, must be approved by parliament.
According to a decree signed last month the agency will now be under parliament's supervision, Bondar said.
Ukraine has yet to sell off any large-scale enterprises. Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko has promised this process would begin this year.
Last week parliament's economic policy committee recommended deputy Alexander Ryabchenko from the eastern industrial city of Dnipropetrovsk as head of the FDM.
